title: Agricultural enterprise lands and agricultural enterprise development.
bodyText: On behalf of the State or in partnership with a federal agency, county, or private party, the department may develop agricultural enterprise lands and agricultural enterprises.
bodyHtml: [§141D-10]  Agricultural enterprise lands and agricultural enterprise development.  On behalf of the State or in partnership with a federal agency, county, or private party, the department may develop agricultural enterprise lands and agricultural enterprises. [L 2022, c 221, pt of §1]
